hot_water_facility.geyser_type: Centralized Solar Water Heating with Electric Backup
hot_water_facility.seasonal_notes: During winter months (Nov - Feb), evening geyser operational hours are extended till 09:30 PM.
hot_water_facility.hot_water_points: Available in all attached and common washrooms on every floor.

iron_box_facility.availability: Available in Common Utility / Ironing Rooms
guidelines: Heavy duty iron boards and steam irons are provided free of charge.
Always switch off and unplug the iron after use.
Personal high-wattage clothes irons inside student bedrooms are prohibited for fire safety reasons.

water_coolers_and_ro.locations: Every floor near the central staircase has an RO drinking water dispenser.
water_coolers_and_ro.features: Dispenses both Chilled and Normal RO-purified water 24/7.
water_coolers_and_ro.maintenance_notice: Filters are serviced on the 1st and 15th of every month.

laundry_facility.washing_machines: Available in basement laundry room from 06:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
laundry_facility.slot_booking: First-come, first-served or via laundry ledger at security desk.
